\caption{Metrics for the four configurations on the three geometries
$\mathbb{T}^{n}$ ($n = 1, 2, 4$), ten seeds each, identical loss and budget
within a geometry ($5\times10^{5}$ iterations on $S^{1}$, $10^{6}$ on
$\mathbb{T}^{2}$ and $\mathbb{T}^{4}$).  Entries are the median over seeds
with the seed range in brackets (in the units of the entry).  Best validation
loss is the minimum over training of the validation loss (Eq.~\eqref{eq:loss}
on a fixed validation set; for the soft-periodic configuration it includes
the extra term of Eq.~\eqref{eq:seam}).  RMS error is the root-mean-square
error against the analytic $V^{*}$ on $2\times10^{5}$ uniform states
($\tau \sim U(0.05, 8)$, $d > \varepsilon$), whose mean on the same states is
$1.84$, $2.55$ and $3.38$ on $S^{1}$, $\mathbb{T}^{2}$ and $\mathbb{T}^{4}$;
$\|\nabla V\|$ at capture is the mean gradient norm in the band
$d \in (\varepsilon, 1.5\varepsilon]$, $\tau \sim U(0.5, 7.5)$, whose analytic
value is $5$; the last column is the share of the same $2\times10^{5}$ states
within $5\%$ of $V^{*}$.}
\label{tab:campaign}
